name: Grade 6 T1 Practice: April Week 1 - Copyright and Images
description: Practice words for choosing safe images and giving credit.

words.definition: A rule that protects a creator's work.
words.example: Copyright means we cannot use every picture we find.

words.definition: A note that says who made something or where it came from.
words.example: The student added credit for the image.

words.definition: The place where information or an image came from.
words.example: The source was written below the picture.

words.definition: Okay to use without causing a problem.
words.example: The class looked for a safe image for the project.

words.definition: Approval to use or share something.
words.example: Some images need permission before use.
